A service holds ordered paths; a path holds ordered segments (19 §6.2). A Historic
path outlives the service's current routing; ordinal keeps tier 1 non-degenerate.

One claim along a path (19 §6.2). A node, not an edge — a Boundary segment has one
endpoint. A segment names its two ports and never the cable: re-patch a cable and
every path through it follows automatically.
